test_DocIntegrationTest: test the DocIntegrationTest class that executes runnable Python code blocks embedded in markdown docs
create_DocIntegrationTest_subclass: create a DocIntegrationTest subclass with doc_path pointing to a markdown file containing runnable code blocks
run_DocIntegrationTest_blocks: run runnable Python code blocks from a markdown doc as individual test methods with contextual failure messages
build_continuation_blocks: build continuation runnable blocks sharing state by appending numeric suffixes like :2 to the block name
parse_pytest_decorators: parse pytest-decorator comments from runnable code blocks and apply them to generated test methods
